title: horizontal_ordinary_forward_fixed_pasting_core_aux
statement: For fixed E, the canonical comparison component identity used in the fixed-comparison core holds.

source.place: Remark 20.28.5 (0ATM), Remark 20.28.3 (08HY), Lemma 20.27.2 (0D5S); fixed comparisons used in Lemma 48.5.2 (0ATR)

proof.text: Obtain j and b with their specified ambient component formulas from rectangle_qcoh_comparison_lifts. Compute the ambient components of the inverse fixed upper comparison by the fully faithful preimage map identity, and identify b with the inverse fixed base comparison by faithfulness.

Apply rectangle_qcoh_ordinary_compatibility to the inverse fixed upper comparison and the obtained j,b. Apply horizontal_transfer_eq_of_inverse_formula to identify j.hom with the canonical transfer. Precompose the rectangle equality with b.inv and postcompose with direct image of s.hom followed by j.hom; cancel the three isomorphism/inverse pairs, substitute b and the transfer identity.

proof_origin.place: Rectangle ordinary compatibility followed by explicit comparison cancellation.

theorem horizontal_ordinary_forward_fixed_pasting_core_aux
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y') (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback f (h ≫ g) : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))
    letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h : Scheme.{u}) :=
      quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let s := horizontalOrdinaryUpperComparison f g h
    let e := pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g h
    let q := pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)
    let p := pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h
    let k := horizontalOrdinaryTransfer e q p (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd f g h)
    let β := qcBaseChange f (h ≫ g)
    let γ := fun E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ↦
      (qcPullback h).map ((qcBaseChange f g).app E) ≫
        (@qcBaseChange _ (pullback f g) Y' Z _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h).app ((qcPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E)
    (horizontalOrdinaryBaseComparison g h).hom.app ((qcDirectImage f).obj E) ≫
          β.app E =
        γ E ≫ (qcDirectImage p).map (s.hom.app E) ≫
          k.app ((qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).obj E)
